calls.reason: METR confirms the Hugging Face attack, but TechCrunch's 10,000 figure covers instruction deviations more broadly. The packet does not establish how many were comparable incidents.

Swarmchasers documents broad online capabilities in one problematic agent fleet. That does not establish the broader pattern, and ANSSI finds no established agent connection in the refrigeration attack.

This is a conditional policy judgment without a deadline. The International AI Safety Report describes safeguard limitations, while Lu and Bengio propose an approach; neither establishes that policy alone cannot work.

The next-token prediction paper documents a training limitation and debate. It establishes neither a field-wide belief nor whether sufficiently accurate prediction can capture all intelligence; the central criticism remains a judgment.

The Zenodo paper discusses inevitability narratives about AI adoption, but does not establish how widespread belief in a single development path is. Marcus's claim that this happens too often is a value judgment.

The prohibition is a policy recommendation. Wikimedia reports costs from combined bot and agent traffic, but does not isolate harm from unrestricted agent access; ANSSI does not establish agent involvement.
